rendererTransform.kind: Append private state/fillDeepList/deepMenuOwner exports and a direct mock mobileHost capability setter before IIFE close. No renderer, owner or protocol-reader replacement.

controlledPreview.boundary: Instrumented renderer DOM/CSS layout only. Real production fillDeepList and its detail/highlight/group renderers use a read-only mock 200-person-count, 2000 backing-person/queue-slot, 38-city world, authenticated complete kind-3 menu DTO, valid current incomplete 13-property personPropertySnapshot and current original-library identity. Fourteen list rows are all produced by actual renderer, including a long name and two identical names with distinct native IDs. Controlled fixture setters change statistics and later set the native snapshot custom flag while keeping hooks empty and menu owner unchanged; the fixture never clears deepSig. Mobile pages receive only a direct mock isAvailable capability assignment; configureMobileHost/start/bind, subscriptions, polling and lifecycle do not run. NativeSnapshot/mobileInputTicket remain production readers of explicit fixture data. No bridge, LIB, WASM, actual game, native input or real storage access is loaded. This grants no actual-flow, physical-device or full-HD acceptance.
controlledPreview.processBoundary: One new owned Chrome persistent profile and private ephemeral allowlist HTTP. Owned pages/context/server closed; no existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.

visualReview.notes: All nine v2 screenshots individually inspected.
